author: PokerFace
body:
Hi, I'm trying my hand at implementing a new sub- gamemode but before I proceed, I have some questions it this can be done with YML.

1. Is it possible to give players only 1 life? (Disable respawning)

2. Is it possible to allow players to throw tnt?

3. Can 1 tnt be given every 10 seconds with a maximum of 3 tnt at a time?

Thanks! I'll be more in depth of this idea in a map release.
